beats.say: A look at how AI assistance has made self-hosting fun again. I never really stopped self-hosting, but I became less inclined to experiment with new things.
There were times when I was quite enthusiastic about it, constantly trying out new software and tinkering with my infrastructure.
Over the last few months, however, I’ve found myself getting increasingly excited about self-hosting again. Maintaining what I already had running was enough for me.
